brief.headline: Fix the 40% return rate first, then qualify a second source — our ₹1.66 L spend is too small to squeeze price hard.

priceAsk.summary: Hold the line on price for now; focus the conversation on quality and reliable supply.
priceAsk.target: Current market asking price for a 28 mm PP cap sits at ₹0.85–0.95/pc, rated MARKET-FAIR with modest room to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume
priceAsk.basis: We spend only ₹1.66 L a year with them — not enough leverage to push a cut today. The market ask shows their pricing is already in the fair zone, so a big discount isn't justified yet. Once quality is stable and volume grows, revisit pricing against the ₹0.65–0.80 band.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Keep the current 30 Days After Receipt terms — no change needed.

brief.financialLeverage: This supplier publishes no financials, so we can't see their revenue, profit or how tight their cash is. That means we build our plan around what we do know: our ₹1.66 L annual spend is very small, so we have almost no spend muscle here. The real leverage is the 40% return rate — it's costing them rework and freight, so they need to fix it as much as we do. Our fallback is to line up one of the four strong alternates and show we're serious about a second source if quality doesn't improve.

evidence.point: Our annual spend with them is tiny
Four in ten items they deliver get sent back
Market asking price for a 28 mm induction-wad PP cap is fair, with modest room at higher volume
evidence.figure: ₹0.55–1.20/pc ask band; ₹0.85–0.95/pc typical; verdict MARKET-FAIR; headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume / looser spec

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd (a lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter for pharma bottles and caps; health score B (65/100), revenue ₹2569.83 Cr — a strong second-source candidate once qualified

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd (a lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader for pails, containers and pharma packaging — a robust alternate for bottles and closures

alternates.name: Pearl Polymers Ltd (a lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: Listed PET bottle and jar specialist — direct fit for PET bottles if we need it

risks: The 40% return rate is bleeding cost on both sides — if it continues, it will kill the relationship before we get any price or term improvement.
Our ₹1.66 L spend gives us almost no negotiating weight — pushing too hard on price or terms could make them walk away or deprioritise our orders.
We have no visibility into their financial health (no public financials) — they could be fragile or rock-solid, so tread carefully until we qualify a second source.
None of the alternates are approved yet — they're all leads that need qualification, audits and pricing before we can credibly threaten to switch.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We want to keep working together, but the 40% return rate is costing both of us — let's fix that first, then talk about growing the business.
